university-of-bristol.description: BILT teaching guidance describes free access for staff and students through the university Microsoft licence, with university-email sign-in. Assessment permission remains task-specific.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Microsoft Copilot
for Edge
browser
is available to all staff and students free of charge through the University Microsoft licence.

the-university-of-warwick.description: Academic Development Centre guidance for educators recommends Copilot. The surrounding data-security guidance addresses systems provided to staff; student eligibility is not established by this extract.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Copilot
is the recommended tool and no special licence is required.
